title: Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) in collaboration with USP conducted a webinar on 23rd Nov. on “Fundamentals of Dissolution” as a part of Capability Building initiative.
bodyHtml:
Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) in collaboration with USP conducted a webinar on 23rd Nov. on “Fundamentals of Dissolution” as a part of CapabilityBuilding initiative. The webinar was conducted “exclusively” for MSME (Micro, small and medium enterprises).

The session conducted by Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi - Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, IPC and Mr. Josan Thomas, Scientific Liaison, USP India, covered the science behind dissolution, fundamentals of dissolution testing, and specifics related to the qualification of USP apparatus 1 and apparatus 2. The session saw great response with 339 participants from 149 unique companies.

Panelists for webinar:Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi - Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, IPC,Dr. Robin Kumar - Principal Scientific Officer, Dr. Gaurav Pratap Singh Jadaun - Senior Scientific Officer, IPC,Mr. Josan Thomas, Scientific Liaison, USP India, Mr. Girish Kapur- Vice President, USP India, Mr. Joseph Eaton - Senior Manager, USP Rockville.

Moderators for webinar: Dr. Meenakshi Dahiya, Principal Scientific Officer, IPC and Ms. Zeenat Khan, Associate Director, USP India.

IPC-USP joint Webinar on “Fundamentals of Dissolution” on 23rd Nov 2021
